title: DCI Drum Corps Scores (2013-2026, cleaned)
subtitle: Cleaned World & Open Class recap scores, captions, judges (2013-2026)
description: Cleaned Drum Corps International (DCI) recap scores for World Class and Open Class, seasons 2013-2026. Wide per-performance totals + 8 caption sub-scores, plus event, corps, per-caption, and judge-assignment tables. Every file is derived from a name-normalized, division-filtered, caption-to-total reconciled domain view - the cleaning pipeline is the point. See README.md for the full data card (provenance, column dictionary, caveats, license, non-affiliation disclaimer). Companion open-source SDK + model: https://github.com/doeixd/dci-score-predictor
userSpecifiedSources: Publicly posted DCI competition recaps, cleaned via the dci-score-predictor domain pipeline
